title: Primate Labs releases Geekbench 7, featuring larger, more demanding datasets for CPUs and GPUs, along with new video and audio encoding/decoding tests, and more (Antonio G. Di Benedetto/The Verge)
summary: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge: Primate Labs releases Geekbench 7, featuring larger, more demanding datasets for CPUs and GPUs, along with new video and audio encoding/decoding tests, and more — It looks and acts like Geekbench 6, but under the hood are larger datasets, new audio / video tests, and more tweaks.
